name: Undertaking 1
definition: Independent undertaking, such as a demand guarantee or standby letter of credit, that provides financial assurance, to be honoured on the presentation of documents that comply with its terms and conditions.

ApplicantReferenceNumber.name: Applicant Reference Number
ApplicantReferenceNumber.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier assigned by the applicant to the undertaking.

Purpose.name: Purpose
Purpose.definition: Brief description of the purpose of the undertaking. Provided as information for the issuer reference.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of undertaking, for example, performance, payment.

Obligor.name: Obligor
Obligor.definition: Party obligated to reimburse the issuer.

Applicant.name: Applicant
Applicant.definition: Party to be named in the undertaking as the “applicant” when different from the obligor.

Issuer.name: Issuer
Issuer.definition: Party that issues the undertaking (or counter-undertaking).

Beneficiary.name: Beneficiary
Beneficiary.definition: Ultimate party in whose favour the undertaking is to be issued.

AdvisingParty.name: Advising Party
AdvisingParty.definition: Party asked to advise the undertaking to the beneficiary or to another advising party.

SecondAdvisingParty.name: Second Advising Party
SecondAdvisingParty.definition: Additional party asked to advise the undertaking.

Confirmer.name: Confirmer
Confirmer.definition: Party that adds its confirmation to the undertaking. For further clarification, reference the applicable rules to which the undertaking is subject.

ConfirmationIndicator.name: Confirmation Indicator
ConfirmationIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the advising bank (confirmer) is requested to add its confirmation to the undertaking. The absence of this element indicates that the advising bank (confirmer) is not requested to add its confirmation to the undertaking.

CounterUndertakingIndicator.name: Counter Undertaking Indicator
CounterUndertakingIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the undertaking is a local or ancillary undertaking to be issued under a counter-undertaking.

CounterUndertaking.name: Counter Undertaking
CounterUndertaking.definition: Details related to the counter undertaking.

UndertakingAmount.name: Undertaking Amount
UndertakingAmount.definition: Details related to the amount of the undertaking.

ExpiryDetails.name: Expiry Details
ExpiryDetails.definition: Details related to the expiry terms of the undertaking.

AdditionalParty.name: Additional Party
AdditionalParty.definition: Party, in addition to the other parties specified in the undertaking, that is also related to the undertaking.

GovernanceRulesAndLaw.name: Governance Rules And Law
GovernanceRulesAndLaw.definition: Rules and laws governing the undertaking.

UnderlyingTransaction.name: Underlying Transaction
UnderlyingTransaction.definition: Details of the underlying transaction for which the undertaking is issued.

PresentationDetails.name: Presentation Details
PresentationDetails.definition: Presentation details related to the undertaking.

UndertakingWording.name: Undertaking Wording
UndertakingWording.definition: Wording details and text for the undertaking.

MultipleDemandIndicator.name: Multiple Demand Indicator
MultipleDemandIndicator.definition: Indicates whether multiple demands are permitted.

PartialDemandIndicator.name: Partial Demand Indicator
PartialDemandIndicator.definition: Indicates whether partial demands/drawings are permitted.

TransferIndicator.name: Transfer Indicator
TransferIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the undertaking is transferable.

TransferChargesPayableBy.name: Transfer Charges Payable By
TransferChargesPayableBy.definition: Indicates whether the applicant/obligor or beneficiary is responsible for payment of the transfer charges.

ConfirmationChargesPayableBy.name: Confirmation Charges Payable By
ConfirmationChargesPayableBy.definition: Indicates whether the applicant/obligor or beneficiary is responsible for payment of the confirmation charges.

AutomaticAmountVariation.name: Automatic Amount Variation
AutomaticAmountVariation.definition: Details related to a variation in amount that is automatically applied.

ObligorLiabilityAccount.name: Obligor Liability Account
ObligorLiabilityAccount.definition: Account nominated by the obligor to record the liability amount of the undertaking.

ObligorChargeAccount.name: Obligor Charge Account
ObligorChargeAccount.definition: Account nominated by the obligor for the settlement of charges related to the undertaking.

ObligorSettlementAccount.name: Obligor Settlement Account
ObligorSettlementAccount.definition: Account nominated by the obligor for the settlement of the amount claimed under the undertaking.

EnclosedFile.name: Enclosed File
EnclosedFile.definition: Document or template enclosed in the undertaking directly related to the undertaking to be issued.

AdditionalApplicationInformation.name: Additional Application Information
AdditionalApplicationInformation.definition: Additional information related to the application for an undertaking.

SecondAdvisingPartyRule.definition: If SecondAdvisingParty is present, then AdvisingParty must be present.

CounterUndertakingYesRule.definition: If CounterUndertakingIndicator is "true" or "1" (Yes), then CounterUndertakingDetails must be present.

CounterUndertakingNoRule.definition: If CounterUndertakingIndicator is "false" or "0" (No), then CounterUndertakingDetails must not be present.
